title: Nano PDF Editor — Edit PDF files with Nano Banana
description:
Nano PDF Editor — a command-line tool that lets you edit PDF slides using nothing but natural language… powered by Nano Banana Pro.  Imagine saying: ‘Update the graph to include data from 2025’ — and it just… does it. Or ‘Turn this chart into a bar graph’ — done instantly. Nano PDF Editor doesn’t just generate new visuals; it can also add entirely new slides that match the original visual style of your deck.

https://github.com/gavrielc/Nano-PDF
